subject: Public tournament description field carries a flag-shaped secret
description: PRODUCTION DATA, needs an operator write to fix. tournaments/wALXlebY6c0uNfGGlYms (Cyber Tech, ended) has a 32-char description matching flag{...}, publicly readable under firestore.rules allow read:if true (:1302). Found by Mallory 2026-09-19, independently confirmed by shape (never printed). Same root cause as taskboard 401: a field written without asking whether an anonymous stranger may read it - the question firestore.rules:1365 tells the next author to ask. Remedy: scrub the field in the admin console, and rotate that flag if it is the graded answer. Value deliberately not recorded here.
